title: OneMax Agent | Speak your thoughts. Turn them into tasks.
excerpt: Mac voice dictation with a cloud notebook: notes group into topics over time, analysis deepens, and ideas become next steps. Free to start.
content_html:
Mac dictation that keeps organizing: topics deepen over time, then become next steps.

Free: 5,000 words a week · Pro launch price $20/month for the first 100 subscribers · Requires macOS 14.4 or later

Cloud notes · Core workspace Demo data Topics, analysis, and tasks keep moving here

Notes sync to the cloud automatically

From one voice note to work that gets done.

Voice is the starting point. OneMax connects scattered thoughts into topics and clear next steps.

01

Capture naturally

Speak as ideas arrive. Capture decisions, inspiration, tasks, and observations without organizing them first.

02

Understand by topic

AI connects related notes, restores context, surfaces the key questions, and develops deeper analysis.

03

Move ideas to completion

Turn analysis into tasks and next steps, then keep progress updated as new notes arrive.

AI doesn't just answer once. It grows with every topic.

Every note, decision, and task stays connected. AI keeps the background, current state, and next step in view.

01

Topic synthesis

Bring fragments from different times and contexts into one continuous line of work.

02

Deep analysis

Surface assumptions, tensions, opportunities, and gaps so the real shape of the problem becomes clear.

03

Task execution

Turn analysis into clear action and feed each new development back into the topic.

One person can have a complete system for getting work done.

Independent creators

Move smoothly from idea capture and topic analysis to planning and publishing.

Founders and managers

Keep meetings, decisions, and actions moving together with fewer gaps and less repetition.

Researchers and professionals

Turn accumulated observations, evidence, and questions into dependable conclusions.

Turn your thoughts into real progress.

Capture naturally, understand deeply, and act with clarity.
